summary: Compares a new flags bitmask a2 against the current state stored in this[1117]. For each changed bit it appends a (property ID, value) pair to a local change list, updating the stored resolution dword this[1263] and its low/high words as needed for the resolution and format mode flags. It then dispatches every queued property change to the device object this[1088] through a vtable method at +200, accumulates each return value into *this, and finally stores a2 as the new current flags.

operations.description: Load the current flags bitmask from this[1117] into a comparison register before diffing against a2.
If the current flags equal the new flags a2, skip change-list building entirely and go straight to finalization.
If bit 4 changed, queue property 22; the value is 1 when the bit is newly set, otherwise the current value of this[1257] (the stored resolution field) is queued.
If bit 0x400 changed, queue property 29 with the boolean of the newly-set state.

If bit 0x800 changed and it is newly cleared, queue property 27 with value 0; when the stored resolution this[1263] differs from 65538, queue sub-property 19 with value 2 when the low word at this+2526 differs from 2, queue sub-property 20 with value 1 when the high word at this+2527 differs from 1, then store 65538 as the new resolution and set the a3 high word to 1.

If bit 0x1000 changed and is newly set, queue property 27 with value 1; when the pending resolution v11 differs from 131074, queue sub-property 19 with value 2 when the low word differs from 2 and sub-property 20 with value 2 when the high word at this+2527 differs from 2, then store 131074 as the resolution and set the a3 high word to 2.
If bit 0x10 changed and is newly set, queue property 9 with value 1.
If bit 0x20 changed and is newly set, queue property 9 with value 1.
If bit 0x100 changed and is newly set, queue property 9 with value 2.
If bit 1 changed, queue property 15 with the boolean of the newly-set state.

Finalization: when the new flags have bit 0x800 set and the pending resolution v11 differs from the stored resolution this[1263], queue sub-property 19 (low word of v11) and sub-property 20 (high word) when they differ from the stored words, then store v11 as the resolution.
Finalization: when the new flags have bit 1 set and a4 differs from this[1264], queue property 24 with value a4 and store a4 into this[1264].
Iterate over the queued change pairs, from index 0 to the built count.
Dispatch each queued (property ID, value) pair by calling the vtable method at +200 on the device object this[1088], passing the device, property ID and value.
Store the dispatch method's return value into *this.
Store a2 as the new current flags bitmask in this[1117].
Void function; no explicit return value.
